q: George Müller yali muntu atya Katonda bulijjo?
a: Nedda n'akatono. Yazaalibwa nga September 27, 1805 okumpi ne Halberstadt, mu bwakabaka bwa Prussia, nga mutabani w'omusolooza w'omusolo, era ng'ebyafaayo bye ye kennyini eby'obwesimbu bwe biraga, yali mulimba era mubbi okuva mu buto, ng'abba ne ku ssente za gavumenti kitaawe ze yali alagiddwa okukuuma, era ng'anywa omwenge n'okuzannya zzaala. Ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'omukaaga yakwatibwa olw'amabanja ge yali tasobola kusasula, n'amala wiiki nnyingi mu kkomera e Wolfenbüttel kitaawe nga tannamuggyayo.

Ku lw'omukaaga olumu akawungeezi mu November 1825, ng'asoma eby'obwakatonda mu Ttendekero Ekkulu ery'e Halle, mukwano gwe ayitibwa Beta n'amuyita mu lukuŋŋaana lutono mu nnyumba y'omuntu, abantu gye baasomeranga Bayibuli, ne bayimba, ne basaba. Omusajja bwe yafukamira n'asaba busabi, Müller n'amenyeka; "Nnali sirabangako muntu yenna ng'afukamidde," bwe yawandiika oluvannyuma, era ye yennyini yali tannafukamira kusaba. Ekiro ekyo n'addayo eka ng'omuntu akyusiddwa, era okuva ku kawungeezi ako olugendo lw'obulamu bwe lwonna ne lukyuka.

q: Kiki ekyamuleeta e Bungereza, era lwaki yaleka omusaala gwe?
a: Mu 1828 yakkirizibwa mu London Society for Promoting Christianity Amongst the Jews, era mu March 1829 n'asaabala emmeeri okugenda Bungereza, wadde nga mu myaka ebiri yali yeeyawudde ku kibiina ekyo olw'amateeka ge yawulira nti gasiba eddembe ly'Omwoyo. Mu 1830 yafuuka omusumba w'ekkanisa entono e Teignmouth mu Devon ku pawundi ataano mu ttaano buli mwaka, n'oluvannyuma n'aleka n'omusaala ogwo ogwabalirwanga, nga kimweraliikiriza nti enkola ey'okupangisa entebe za kkanisa yafuula Enjiri eky'okugulawo era n'ereka abaavu nga bakwatibwa ensonyi. Yayagala okwesiga Katonda butereevu mu kifo ky'enteekateeka yonna ey'abantu.

q: Kya mazima nti teyasabako muntu yenna ssente okuggyako Katonda?
a: Yee — gwali musingi omunywevu ogw'obulamu bwe bwonna. Yamalirira obutaddayo kusaba muntu munne ssente, wadde okuleka obwetaavu bwe okumanyibwa, wabula okubutegeeza Katonda yekka mu kusaba n'alindirira eky'okuddamu. Era yagaana okuyingira mu bbanja olw'omulimu gwa Katonda, ng'alowooza nti ssente bwe zaabanga tewali, Katonda yali tannamuyita kuzikozesa.

q: Amaka g'abaana bamulekwa ag'e Ashley Down gaali ki?
a: Omulimu gw'abaana bamulekwa gwava mu Scriptural Knowledge Institution for Home and Abroad, Müller gye yatandikawo mu Bristol mu 1834 okuyamba amasomero, okusaasaanya Bayibuli n'okuwagira abaminsani ku musingi gwe gumu ogw'okusaba mu kifo ky'okusaba abantu ssente. Yaggulawo ennyumba y'abaana bamulekwa esooka ku Wilson Street mu April 1836, era oluvannyuma n'azimba ennyumba ttaano ennene ku Ashley Down, abaana ng'enkumi bbiri mwe baabeeranga omulundi gumu. Mu bulamu bwe bwonna yalabirira bamulekwa 10,024, era teyali n'omulundi gumu gwe yasabako ssente mu lujjudde wadde okutambuza essowaani ey'okukuŋŋaanya ebiweebwayo.

q: Kya mazima nti bamulekwa baali balidde eky'enkya ekyajja ng'eky'okuddamu eky'okusaba?
a: Ku makya agamu, nga mu nnyumba temuli mmere era nga tewali ssente ya kugigula, Müller yatuuza abaana ku meeza empanvu n'awa Katonda okwebaza olw'eky'enkya kye baali bagenda okufuna. Okwebaza bwe kwaggwa ne wabaawo okukonkona ku luggi: yali muyokya migaati eyali tasobodde kwebaka, ng'akakasa nti bamulekwa baali bagenda okwetaaga omugaati, era n'agolokoka mu makya ennyo n'abafumbira. Oluvannyuma lwa kaseera katono, omutunzi w'amata, eggaali ye nga emenyekedde mu luguudo mu maaso g'ennyumba, n'abeegayirira batwale amata ge gonna mu kifo ky'okugaleka ne gaayonooneka, era abaana abaali bakutamye mu maaso g'essowaani enkalu ne balya eky'enkya ekijjuvu eky'omugaati omuggya n'amata.

q: Yeetegekanga atya nga tannasabira bwetaavu obungi obw'olunaku?
a: Yazuula nti teyandisobodde kusaba bulungi ng'ava mu mutima ogweraliikirira era omuyereere, n'olwekyo buli makya yatuulanga mu Byawandiikibwa nga tayimirira okutuusa emmeeme ye ng'esanyufu mu Mukama. "Ekintu ekisooka eky'okufaako," bwe yawandiika, "tekyali nti nnaaweereza Mukama nnyo ntya, wadde nti nnaagulumiza ntya Mukama; wabula nti nnaatuusa ntya emmeeme yange mu mbeera ey'essanyu, era omuntu wange ow'omunda anaaliisibwa atya." Olwo n'alyoka akyukira okusaba olw'obwetaavu obw'enkumi obw'olunaku olwo.

q: Tumanyi ki ku maka ge, era ennaku yagyolekera atya?
a: Nga October 7, 1830 yawasa Mary Groves, mwannyina w'omuminsani Anthony Norris Groves, eyagabana buli kubonaabona kw'omulimu nga teyeemulugunya okumala emyaka nga amakumi ana, okutuusa lwe yafa olw'omusujja gw'amagumba nga February 6, 1870; bamulekwa lukumi mu bina ne bagoberera essanduuko ye. Ng'omutima gumuluma, Müller yabuulira ye yennyini okubuulira okw'okuziika kwe okuva mu Zabbuli 119, "Ggwe oli mulungi, era okola ebirungi," ng'agamba nti: "Katonda yennyini y'akikoze; tumumatidde." Muwala we Lydia, eyazaalibwa mu 1832, yakulira mu bamulekwa n'afumbirwa omuyambi we omwesigwa era omusika we James Wright, era mu 1871 n'awasa omulundi ogw'okubiri, Susannah Grace Sanger.

q: Kiki kye yakola mu bukadde bwe?
a: Ng'ennyumba z'abaana bamulekwa ziri mu mikono egyesigika, Müller — ng'ayise emyaka nsanvu — n'atandika okugenda okubuulira. Okuva mu 1875 okutuuka mu 1892 yatambula, ng'abala ye yennyini, mayiro nga emitwalo abiri mu mawanga amakumi ana mu abiri — okuyita mu Bulaaya, Amerika, Buyindi, China, Japan ne Australia — ng'abuulira ebibiina oluusi ebyabalibwanga mu nkumi. Yatwala obubaka bwe bumu obwangu buli wamu: nti Katonda wa mazima, nti akwata ekigambo kye, era nti okusaba kuddibwamu.

q: George Müller yawandiika ki, era ajjukirwa atya?
a: Omulimu gwe omukulu bwe bitabo ebingi ebiyitibwa "A Narrative of Some of the Lord's Dealings with George Müller," mwe yawandiikira omwaka ku mwaka, mu bwegendereza bw'omubazi w'ebitabo, obwetaavu bw'omulimu n'ebyokuddamu ebyabutuukiriza; ekitabo ekimpikiriziddwa kyafuluma nga "The Life of Trust," n'ebimu ku byaweebwa ebyawandiikibwa nga "Answers to Prayer." Yakola kumpi okutuuka ku nkomerero, era ku makya aga March 10, 1898, mu kisenge kye ku Ashley Down era mu mwaka ogw'ekyenda mu esatu ogw'obulamu bwe, yasangibwa ng'afudde ku mabbali g'ekitanda kye. Yafa ng'omusajja omwavu, nga kumpi teyeetereka kintu, era mu kifo ky'ekyo n'aleka ekyo kye yali agenderedde okuleka: ekyafaayo eky'obwesimbu era ekinene ennyo nti Katonda akyawulira okusaba.
